$comment: The source of sf-menu's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/menu (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

count.summary: A count by its own name: the same as a badge holding a whole number (the class counter).

status.summary: A status dot of that tone at the row's end, before the counter; its word ends the link's name («Адрес, внимание»).

region.summary: A row's first-level branch that opens a region (a mega menu) under the header instead of a panel: the name of a <template slot="region-<name>"> written inside the element, any markup; without that template the region draws the item's children as columns. In a column, a deeper level or the «Ещё» panel it is an ordinary branch.

target.summary: The link's target (_blank for a new tab, with rel noopener). A target other than _self draws ↗ after the words, and _blank says in the link's name that it opens in a new tab.

external.summary: A link that leaves the site without a target of its own: ↗ after the words (data-external on the <li> or the <a> in markup).

group.summary: A first-level item that is a group: a heading over its items (children, or items), never a destination. Its items are first-level rows. A row and the compact rail draw the items in the group's place, without the heading.

collapsible.summary: A group whose heading is a button that opens and closes it (aria-expanded); a group is open unless open is false.

items.summary: A group's items, the same as children, by the shape of a grouped navigation {groups:[{label, items}]}.

items.x-markup: the attribute takes the same list as JSON; without it a nested <ul><li><a> written inside is the menu; children has the same shape
items.summary: The items, [{id, label, href?, icon?, badge?, count?, status?, current?, disabled?, open?, region?, target?, external?, children?}] and first-level groups {group: true, label, collapsible?, open?, items}: an array in the property, the same array as JSON in the attribute. Without items the element reads the nested <ul><li><a> written inside it (data-group, data-collapsible and data-status on an <li>).

orientation.summary: vertical: a column whose branches open in place; horizontal: the first level in a row, each branch a panel below it (deeper ones to the side), placed by the Framework's geometry.

appearance.summary: The class menu's presentations: default; documentation-tree, the tree with no borders and an indent per level; compact, a rail of first-level icons whose words stay in the link's name and whose branches do not open (both columns); navigation, a site header's sections -- rows with no frame and no fill at rest, a state-layer fill under the pointer and a plate on the current page -- a row or a column as orientation says.

current-from-location.summary: Without current, the item whose link leads to location.pathname is the current page (a trailing slash and index.html do not matter); a link to a section of the page (#address) is current while location.hash names it. History navigation is followed.

collapse.summary: auto: a row that does not fit its width becomes a button opening the same links as a column (with overflow collapse, the default), and a row again when the width is back; always: the button whatever the orientation; narrow: the button while the page is narrower than the md breakpoint (a phone), and then a selector -- its words and icon are the current item's; none: never.

overflow.summary: What a row does when its first level does not fit (the values of sf-tabs' overflow where they mean the same): more, priority+ -- the items that do not fit leave the row from its end for a trailing «Ещё» branch (more-label), the section that holds the current page stays while it fits beside it, and with no item left «Ещё» reads «Меню» (toggle-label); collapse, the row becomes the button (collapse auto); none, the row stays whole. sf-menu-overflow says which items left.

more-label.summary: The words of the «Ещё» branch of a row with overflow more; «Ещё» / «More» in the page language when not set.

open-on.summary: How a row's branch opens with a mouse: hover (the default), a mouse resting on a branch opens it after 300 ms -- a region after 500 ms -- and it closes 500 ms after the mouse has left the branch and its panel (NN/g, WCAG 1.4.13); click, only a press. Touch, a pen and the keyboard always go through the branch's chevron: a section that is a page is a split control, its name a link and the chevron beside it a button «<раздел>: подразделы» (C30, APG disclosure navigation with top-level links).

indicator.summary: How a row marks its first-level section that is the current page or holds it (C30, R060): line (the default), a 2 px primary line under the whole control lying on the header's bottom border, as the tabs do (sf-header-site publishes that edge), and a medium label; fill, the C23 plate, for a header with no bottom border (over a photo, transparent). An open section has the neutral select plate, never primary.

label.summary: The navigation's name (aria-label of its <nav>); the element's aria-label, or the one of a <nav> written inside it, when not set.

toggle-label.summary: The words of the button a collapsed menu becomes; «Меню» / «Menu» in the page language when not set.

sticky.summary: The menu stays in sight while the page scrolls (position sticky at --sf-menu-sticky-top, 0 by default), and scrolls inside itself when it is taller than the view. For a section navigation beside a long page.

bordered.summary: A column with a border of its own (C30 amended 2026-11-09, R072 e): a hairline of outline-variant at the surface radius, the plates space-1/4 in from it on every side, and the path to the current page marked by a 2 px primary line on its start border at the closed branch that holds it, besides the medium label. Without it a column has no frame and marks the path with the medium label alone (R065 a). A row ignores it: its panels always have the line (R084).

search.summary: A search field over a column (C30 amended 2026-11-09, R071 a; off by default, never by the number of items): the rows are filtered as the field is typed in -- without case, ё as е, on the items' words and the group headings; a match keeps its parents, opened, a matching item keeps its children, closed, a matching heading keeps its group -- and the matched words are highlighted (::highlight(sf-menu-match), --sf-mark). Down from the field enters the results, Down and Up walk them, Up from the first goes back; Escape clears the field, or goes back to it from the results. A polite live region says how many matched; «Ничего не найдено» when none. The field stands still and the rows scroll when the host gives the menu a height. A row ignores it.

search-placeholder.summary: The words in the search field, and its name; «Поиск» / «Search» in the page language when not set.

current.summary: the id of the current page's item; with current-from-location the location decides

navigate.summary: A link of the menu is pressed to go to its page in the same tab: id, href and item of the link. Cancel it to route the page yourself; the browser then does not go. A press that opens another tab or window does not fire it.

toggle.summary: A branch opened or closed: id and item of the branch (null for the panel of a collapsed menu's button), open, and source -- user for a press, a key, the pointer resting or leaving, or focus leaving the menu; method for open, close, toggle and close-all. Fires once for each branch that changed.

overflow.summary: A row with overflow more changed which first-level items it shows: hidden, the ids of the items now in «Ещё», in their order (empty when all fit again).

search.summary: The search field's words changed: query, the words trimmed (empty when cleared), and count, how many item words and group headings match.

open.summary: Open the branch with this id. In a row the panels not above it close. sf-menu-toggle fires for each branch that changed, source method. Answers an outcome: applied, or refused with unknown, compact, disabled, already, or fixed for a group that is not collapsible or that a row does not draw.

close.summary: Close the branch with this id; in a row the panels inside it close too. Answers an outcome: applied, or refused with unknown, compact, disabled, already, or fixed for a group that is not collapsible or that a row does not draw.

toggle.summary: Open the branch if it is closed, close it if it is open. Answers an outcome: applied, or refused with unknown, compact, disabled, already, or fixed for a group that is not collapsible or that a row does not draw.

close-all.summary: Close a row's open panels and the panel of the button a collapsed menu is; a column's groups keep their state. Answers an outcome: applied when anything closed, else refused with already.

relations.name: dot
$comment: An item's status is the class dot of its tone (.sf-dot), drawn by the dot
sheet without an element per row.

relations.name: cl-input
$comment: The search field over a column (search, C30 amended R071 a) is sf-input; the page that loads the menu on demand fetches it.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

skeleton.$comment: The items arrive after the first paint when the host loads them: the derived skeleton (static/default/<example>.skeleton.html) holds their box until they do (standard 1.3.8 §5.4).

Escape.x-when: any of: a row's open panel (appearance default or navigation), or the panel of the menu drawn as a button (collapse always, or narrow under the md breakpoint); a column's groups are no surface and keep Escape for the page

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-menu for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split (the old detail from the element's adapter), host-attribute (no shim).

rows.note: {id, href, item} is data only; one cancel for both names
rows.summary: A link of the menu is followed, before the browser goes. Cancellable: preventDefault() stops the navigation so a host that routes itself (a SPA) changes the page. A press with a modifier key, the middle button or a link to another window is the browser's and sends none.

rows.note: {id, open, source, item} is data only
rows.summary: A branch opened or closed, by the person (source user) or a method (source method): the branch asked for first, then the ones that closed with it, innermost first. The panel of a collapsed menu sends it with id null.

x-summary: Site navigation built from data -- nested sections, the current page, groups that open and close -- or from a nested list of links in the markup, drawn as the class menu: a column whose branches open in place, or a row whose branches open as panels placed by SF.Position, which becomes a button opening the same links when it does not fit. The WAI-ARIA disclosure navigation pattern, not an application menu.
x-renamed: events.sf-menu:navigate → navigate: vocabulary §5 navigate, the DOM name sf-menu-navigate; the colon name a dated same-detail alias
events.sf-menu:toggle → toggle: the DOM name sf-menu-toggle (§8, §16 item 6); the colon name a dated same-detail alias
x-decisions: version: 1.0.0 → 1.1.0, a minor while sf-menu:navigate and sf-menu:toggle hold dated aliases (§4.10).

events: sf-menu:navigate → sf-menu-navigate (vocabulary §5 navigate {id, href}) and sf-menu:toggle → sf-menu-toggle, by the alias table; their details hold data only (item is the menu's own entry, never an element), so both rows are same-detail, and navigate's cancel is shared: a page that refuses either name keeps the browser where it is.
toggle reports a person (source user) and a call (source method), as before: it is a branch's fact, not `change` (§8). The panel of the menu drawn as a button reports id null and item null.
actions: open, close and toggle {id} and close-all answer an outcome (applied; refused unknown, compact, disabled, already) instead of true/false (§4.4).

keyboard (simai/ui-source#44 item 2): Escape is declared where it acts -- on a panel (keyboard.panel), and in accessibility.keys with `when`, any of a row's layout (orientation horizontal, appearance default) or the menu drawn as a button (collapse always; collapse auto draws one only from a row). A column's groups are no surface, so Escape stays the page's there, as the browser probe has asserted since the menu shipped.

key-effects: links and branch buttons are native: Tab reaches them, Enter follows a link or toggles a branch, Space toggles a branch (select); no arrow keys -- the WAI-ARIA disclosure navigation pattern, not an application menu.
a11y-name: aria-label on the host, then label, then the aria-label of a <nav> or <ul> written inside.

instance ids (§7.1.1, simai/ui-source#41): the list and panel ids came from a module counter (sf-smart-menu-<n>); they are the host's path id and a local name now, <path>--list and <path>--menu-<n>, n the item's place in this element's own map; the class menu's submenu ids are its path id and --submenu.
item-shape: items name their fields with `of` (id, label, href, icon, badge, current, disabled, open, children); label is text, never markup.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows.

examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and studio.scenario.json plus a row, the documentation tree and the menu drawn as a button; probe.json drives Tab, Enter, Space and Escape in a row and in a column (gate 16).
css-variables: the nine public variables the sheet already reads (src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json).

layer: none declared. A row's open panel and the button's panel hold the shared open-surface mark (core/js/open-surface-mark), so a drawer or modal behind stands back on Escape; they are placed by SF.Position in place, not moved to the end of body (side-effects: none).

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.

version 1.1.3: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.2.0: appearance navigation (owner decision by recommendation, 2026-11-01), the look of a site header's sections as Docara draws them, so a header needs no classes of its own over the menu: rows with no border and no fill at rest, text on-surface at the class row's size 1 height, padding, type and ui radius; hover and press the state family of the alpha scale (--sf-surface-transparent-hover 4, -active 12), an open branch the select step (8), the current page the fill family's plate --sf-surface-container-active (24, the same step in both themes on the theme's neutral tone, as the token sets it); forced colours frame the current page instead. It is a row or a column as orientation says, so a row's panels, the collapse to a button and the keyboard are the default's. The look comes from the class sheet src/component/menu 1.1.0.

version 1.2.4 (2026-11-07): a patch (a look). A row's label badge carries sf-badge--tight, and a row's counter (.sf-badge[data-count]) takes the same tight room from the badge sheet: component.badges 1.2.0 widened a badge's default side room to --sf-space-1/2 (owner decision, docs review R020), and a menu row is a dense place. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.0 (2026-11-08, Larena msg-993e1e39 item 4 -- section navigation for an entity page): a minor, all additions. First-level groups {group: true, label, collapsible?, open?, items | children}: a heading (words, or a disclosure button with aria-expanded when collapsible) over a list the heading names (aria-labelledby); the group's items are first-level rows, so the text axis is the rows' own and the heading's words stand on it. A group is open unless open is false; one that is not collapsible is always open, and open/close/toggle refuse it with reason fixed; a row and the compact rail draw the items in the group's place. An item's status (success, warning, error, info, neutral) is the class dot (component dot) at the row's end before the counter, its word in the link's name; count is badge's count by its own name. collapse narrow: the menu is the button under the md breakpoint and the button is a selector showing the current item (its icon and words, named «<label>: <item>»). sticky keeps the menu in sight (--sf-menu-sticky-top, the tenth public variable). current-from-location matches a section link (#address) against location.hash, so in-page panels and real URLs both work. Not a second tabs component: sf-tabs stays the tab strip of one panel set; this is navigation (WAI-ARIA disclosure, no roles of an application menu).

version 1.3.1 (2026-11-09): a patch, nothing drawn or done differently. The generated reference gives each action's method its one object argument, open({id}), close({id}), toggle({id}), where it read the parameters one by one (standard §4.4: the parameters arrive as one object); the element's code also takes the value alone, open(<string>), close(<string>), toggle(<string>), and the reference says so (x-registry.action-calls). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.4.1 (2026-11-09): a minor (decision C23, owner 2026-11-09). A navigation menu marks the current page with a primary plate (--sf-primary-container-active, on-primary-container ink, a medium label) and no bar; an open branch is no longer filled; a closed branch, or a rail row, above the current page takes a primary bar at its inline start, written by sf-menu as sf-menu-element--holds-current. One above the released 1.3.1 and C23's 1.4.0.

version 1.5.0 (2026-11-09, owner decision C30 refined after remarks R057-R060, study control/research/2026-11-09-menu-simple.md section 8, prototype prototypes/menu-simple.html): a minor, all additions, and the looks the decision fixes. One tag, four looks: the site row (orientation horizontal, appearance navigation), the site column (four levels, C23 built in), the simple admin (the column with icons on the first level, density compact, two levels) and the phone (the same tree in sf-header-site's panel, the path to the current page open; no drill-in). New settings: overflow more|collapse|none (default collapse, today's behaviour; more is priority+ -- the items that do not fit leave the row from its end for a trailing «Ещё» branch, the section holding the current page stays while it fits beside it, «Меню» when none is left), more-label (the «Ещё» words, lang more-label), open-on hover|click (default hover: a mouse opens a panel after 300 ms, a region after 500 ms, closes 500 ms after leaving; touch, pen and keys through the chevron), indicator line|fill (default line). A section that is a page and has subsections is a split control in the row and in its panels: the name a link, the chevron a button named «<раздел>: подразделы» (lang subsections); no «all items» row in a panel or a region. An item's region names a <template slot="region-<name>">: a row's first-level branch opens a region as wide as the header under it, holding that markup, or its children as columns without one. Event sf-menu-overflow {hidden: [ids]}. A row's side panels stand beside their panel (past its padding and border by space-1/4, the first row level with the branch) and flip at the window's edge; the chevron of a side branch is always › (R059). The first panel stands space-1/4 under its branch. The row's current section: a 2 px line on the header's bottom border (sf-header-site publishes the edge as --sf-site-header--edge) and a medium label, or the C23 plate with indicator fill (R060); an open branch of the row and of its panels has the neutral select plate; a closed panel row that holds the current page has a medium label and a primary › (R057), no bar. Arrow keys in a row (the optional keys of the WAI-ARIA disclosure pattern); a column keeps none. The class sheet (component.menu 1.5.0): one indent step (space-1) per level, the second level's words under the first level's when it has icons, the row's line, fill, open plate and panel path, the region. Names settled: overflow, more-label, open-on, indicator, region + <template slot="region-<name>">, sf-menu-overflow {hidden}; the trailing branch's id is @more, so an item id starting with @ is renamed by its place. Acceptance (DEV 2026-11-09): a row's first panel and «Ещё»'s stand the gap under the header's edge (--sf-site-header--edge), so the current section's line stays in sight; an open path row keeps its medium label and primary › on the select plate; side levels take the side with room for the whole chain and keep it (no zig-zag); a row's icon box is the line's size, so a phone's icon row is no taller than its neighbours.

version 1.6.0 (2026-11-09, owner decision C30 amended in ui-control 9a86d1a1 after R065, R070-R072, R083, R084; C05, C06, C07; prototype prototypes/menu-simple.html #r084, #r065-sec, #r071-sec, #r083; study control/research/2026-11-09-menu-simple.md rounds 4-5): a minor. The path to the current page has one sign: a medium label, and where the box the row stands in has a border of its own -- every panel of a row, a column with bordered -- a 2 px primary line on that border at the row, covering the border pixel, the row's height, inner corners rounded, clear of the corner's curve on the box's first and last row, one pixel inside while the box scrolls (sf-menu writes sf-menu--scroll). The › of a panel row is neutral again: it says only that there is a level under the row (R084, replacing the primary › of 1.5.0). A column without a border marks a closed branch on the path with the medium label alone (R065 a); the 3 px bar is retired everywhere: the compact rail, whose rows are an icon alone, takes the same 2 px line on its start edge without the weight (DEV answer b). With search, bordered frames the whole menu, the head with the rows, with no hairline under the head (DEV acceptance minor 1). The scrollbar's gap is given back only when the menu's own list scrolls; a sticky menu or a column in a page scroller keeps the full inset. An item's key, text and title are read as the first release's spellings of id and label until 2027-01-01 and declared nowhere (journal sf-menu-item-field-aliases). New settings: bordered (R072 e), search and search-placeholder (R071 a), event sf-menu-search {query, count}; items take target and external (↗; _blank adds rel noopener and «откроется в новой вкладке» to the link's name). A column's group headings are a row's height, the rows' size and weight of type, on-surface-variant, the words on the first level's line (R070). A column's plates stand space-1/4 in from its edge on both sides, the words space-1/2 in from the plate, each deeper level space-1 further; a column whose scrollbar takes room gives the scrollbar's own gap back from its end padding (sf-menu--scrollbar, C07). The search field is sf-input (filled, rounded), its magnifier over the rows' icons (C06), with no size of its own, so a compact region takes it to the rows' height.

version 1.6.2 (2026-11-12, owner remark R179, DEV evidence control/evidence/2026-11-12-menu-phone-integrity D1-D4; decisions C30, C18): a patch. D1: a row that stays a row below md (sf-header-site collapse none, or a bare row with overflow more) has no room for side panels -- the levels under the first panel now open in place inside it, as a column's levels do (data-sf-menu-in-place, a space-1 step per level, the path's line on the first panel's border), instead of being anchored beside it, where they stood 140-196 px outside the viewport and level 4 over level 2; at md and above nothing changes. C30's phone stays the tree in sf-header-site's drawer; no drill-in. D2: the split control's link takes the row's block padding into its own box (the row's height, 44 in the phone's drawer, not the 20 of its words) and reaches the row's start edge; under a coarse pointer the chevron of a column's split control is a square of the row's height (44 x 44 in the drawer), flush with the row's inner end edge, its glyph where it stood. D3: open, close, toggle and close-all declare their outcome object ({outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason}) as x-returns, as the runtime answers; isOpen stays a boolean. D4: events navigate and toggle carry a summary. 1.6.1 is taken by the unreleased branch fix/menu-open-and-api.

version 1.6.1 (2026-11-11, owner remark on the ui-doc sf-menu page, example «Строка с панелями»: «Каталог» has open: true and drew no panel; diagnosis ui-control control/evidence/2026-11-11-owner-remarks-diag): a patch. A row honours an item's open flag as a column does: a row's panels are one chain, so the first flagged first-level branch opens its panel at first, and inside it the first flagged branch of each level its side panel (aria-expanded true, panel shown on the first render and when the items change). A disabled branch opens nothing; the current page alone still opens nothing in a row; what the person or the host opened and closed wins over the flag; a branch the flag opened closes on Escape, a press outside, another branch and hover-out, as any open panel does.

$comment: sf-menu loads on demand like any other Smart element. It draws the class
menu's markup, so the class menu is what it draws with: its sheet (and its
runtime, which leaves the element's markup alone), the icon font for the
glyphs and the icon-button box of a branch, and the class counter, which
the badges runtime caps and names.

id.description: The item's name in open(id), close(id), toggle(id), current and the events; its place (item-1, item-1-2…) without it. One id names one item in the whole tree: a repeated one is left out with its children.

label.description: The row's words. Text, never markup.

href.description: The page the item leads to. An item with neither an address nor children is words in the row's place.

icon.description: An icon before the label, a name from the icon font.

badge.description: A whole number is the class counter (capped at 99+, hidden at 0, its phrase ends the link's name); other text is a short label after the words.

count.description: A count by its own name: the same as a badge holding a whole number (the class counter).

status.description: A status dot of that tone at the row's end, before the counter; its word ends the link's name.

current.description: The item is the current page, unless the element's current names another or current-from-location finds one.

disabled.description: Unavailable: a link without an address, a branch the person cannot open or close.

open.description: A column's branch is open at first; in a row the first flagged branch of each level opens its panel at first.

children.description: Nested items, the same shape: an item with them is a branch. The class menu draws four levels; a deeper one is drawn as the fourth.

region.description: A row's first-level branch opens a region (a mega menu) instead of a panel: the name of a <template slot="region-<name>"> inside the element, else its children drawn as columns.

target.description: The link's target (_blank for a new tab, with rel noopener). A target other than _self draws ↗ after the words; _blank says in the link's name that it opens in a new tab.

external.description: A link that leaves the site without a target of its own: ↗ after the words.

group.description: A first-level item that is a group: a heading over its items, never a destination. A row and the compact rail draw the items in the group's place, without the heading.

collapsible.description: A group whose heading is a button that opens and closes it (aria-expanded); a group is open unless open is false.

items.description: A group's items, the same as children.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-menu for site, section or cabinet navigation that comes from data or from a nested list of links: a header row, a side panel, a documentation tree.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not use it for actions on a selected object: that is sf-context-menu
Do not add role=menu: it is navigation, a list of links
Do not put markup in label: it is shown as text
Do not restyle its rows: they are the class menu's, set its public variables
Do not use sf-admin-menu for site navigation: it is the Pro admin menu
Do not make a mega menu of a column: region is a row's first level only

accessibility.focus: A <nav> named by label, of native links and, for each branch, a native button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; a branch that is also a page has its link and its button side by side in the row. Tab walks the links and the buttons in order; Enter and Space open and close a branch; Escape closes the innermost open panel only -- a row's deepest open panel, the one the focus is in first, else the panel of the collapsed menu's button -- and gives the focus back to its button, holding the shared open-surface mark so a drawer or a modal behind stands back. Focus leaving a row closes its panels. In a row the arrows are the optional keys of the pattern: Left and Right walk the first level, Home and End go to its ends, Down and Up open a branch and enter its panel; in a panel Down and Up walk its rows, Right opens a side panel, Left closes it and gives the focus back; in a region Down and Up walk its links, Left and Right its columns. A column has no arrows. The current page's link has aria-current="page". No role=menu.

sf-menu:navigate.summary: A link of the menu is followed, before the browser goes. Cancellable: preventDefault() stops the navigation so a host that routes itself (a SPA) changes the page. A press with a modifier key, the middle button or a link to another window is the browser's and sends none.

item.description: The item as the element draws it.

sf-menu:toggle.summary: A branch opened or closed, by the person (source user) or a method (source method): the branch asked for first, then the ones that closed with it, innermost first. The panel of a collapsed menu sends it with id null.

isOpen.summary: Whether the branch with this id is open.

id.description: The item's name in open(id), close(id), toggle(id), current and the events; its place (item-1, item-1-2…) without it. One id names one item in the whole tree: a repeated one is left out with its children.

label.description: The row's words. Text, never markup.

href.description: The page the item leads to. An item with neither an address nor children is words in the row's place.

icon.description: An icon before the label, a name from the icon font.

badge.description: A whole number is the class counter (capped at 99+, hidden at 0, its phrase ends the link's name); other text is a short label after the words.

current.description: The item is the current page, unless the element's current names another or current-from-location finds one.

disabled.description: Unavailable: a link without an address, a branch the person cannot open or close.

open.description: A column's branch is open at first; in a row the first flagged branch of each level opens its panel at first.

children.description: Nested items, the same shape: an item with them is a branch. The class menu draws four levels; a deeper one is drawn as the fourth.

region.description: A row's first-level branch opens a region (a mega menu) instead of a panel: the name of a <template slot="region-<name>"> inside the element, else its children drawn as columns.
